title: When Can You Trust an Agent's Own Verifier? Stress-Testing Counterfactual Rationale Verification Under Search Pressure and Oracle Access
abstract: arXiv:2610.22779v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated agent design increasingly trusts a single score to decide whether a change is an improvement -- but a score optimized aggressively enough ceases to measure what it was meant to. When an agent also explains its design, that explanation is a second signal we can check without human labels: negate each stated claim, re-run, and observe whether performance drops. We ask whether such a verifier stays reliable once an agent optimizes against it. Our contribution is not a new verifier but a way to stress-test one: a pressure ratio $\rho$ measuring how much the verifier steers the agent's search, and four falsifiable probes covering four failure modes -- giving no signal, being too weak to matter, being gamed by stating fewer claims, and being queried before the agent commits. We apply the test to our own verifier, the Rationale Consistency Score (RCS), inside an LLM agent that designs machine-learning pipelines, with one generator mod

translated_title: 何时可以信任智能体自身的验证器？在搜索压力与预言机访问下对反事实理由验证进行压力测试
translated_abstract: 自动化智能体设计越来越信任单一分数来决定某项改动是否是一种改进——但当分数被足够激进地优化时，它就不再能衡量其原本要衡量的东西。当智能体同时解释其设计时，该解释是一个我们可以无需人工标注即可检查的第二信号：否定每一条声明的论断，重新运行，并观察性能是否下降。我们要问的是：一旦智能体针对该验证器进行优化，这样的验证器是否仍然可靠。我们的贡献不是一个新的验证器，而是一种对验证器进行压力测试的方法：一个衡量验证器对智能体搜索引导程度的压力比 ρ，以及四个可证伪的探针，覆盖四种失败模式——不提供任何信号、过于微弱而不起作用、通过声明更少的论断来钻空子，以及在智能体提交之前就被查询。我们将该测试应用于我们自己的验证器——理由一致性分数，在一个由LLM驱动的、设计机器学习流水线的智能体中进行测试。
tldr: 本文提出了一种通过压力比ρ和四个可证伪探针来压力测试智能体自身验证器的方法，用于检验当智能体针对验证器进行优化时，反事实理由验证是否仍然可靠。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a stress-testing methodology for agent self-verifiers, using a pressure ratio ρ and four falsifiable probes to examine whether counterfactual rationale verification remains reliable once an agent optimizes against it.
